description:
What this does. Once a job offer is signed, open it and use Clinic › Register & Request Wellness. That does two things in one go: it signs the person up with the clinic, and it books their health check for the next two weeks.

You can do this for several people at once from the job offer list.

You do not have to do anything else — when the clinic has seen them, their result comes back on its own and appears on the offer.
name: Request a Pre-Employment Wellness Test
title: Send a new hire for a health check
